Q6163.reason: Pregnancy raises pelvic venous pressure and is a classic predisposing factor; haemorrhoidal bleeding is fresh red not melaena, first-degree bleeding is painless, and second-degree piles reduce spontaneously.

Q6165.reason: Insulin drives GLUT4-mediated uptake in muscle and fat only; brain, red cells, liver and several other tissues take up glucose independently of insulin, so 'all tissues' is false while A–C are true.

Q6172.reason: A peripheral nerve palsy such as ulnar nerve palsy is a lower motor neurone lesion; LMN signs are hypotonia, hyporeflexia and fasciculations, not hypertonia or brisk reflexes.
